definitions.explanation: Curiosity or attention directed toward something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興味|きょうみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.notes: 〜に{興味|きょうみ}がある pattern

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興味|きょうみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}った→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: I became interested in Japanese history.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ポスター→ポスター：09598_posutaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興味|きょうみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれた→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: I was drawn to that movie's poster.
examples.notes: {興味|きょうみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ = to attract interest

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勧|すす}められて→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧{興味|きょうみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}った→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦やってみたら→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}に→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}かった→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
examples.english: A friend recommended it and I got interested, and when I tried it, it was really fun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しか→しか：09959_shika⟧{興味|きょうみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{色々|いろいろ}な→色々：02352_iroiro⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興味|きょうみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦ように→よう：01114_you⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child I was only interested in insects, but as I grew up I became interested in many things.

notes:
{興味|きょうみ} means 'interest' in the sense of curiosity — the pull something exerts on your attention. It is a noun, so English 'I'm interested in X' becomes X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興味|きょうみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧, literally 'interest in X exists.' Note the particle: the thing you are interested in takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, not ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.

Key patterns:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興味|きょうみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be interested in ~
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興味|きょうみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to take an interest in ~
- {興味|きょうみ}⟦{深|ぶか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧: deeply interesting

Note: {興味|きょうみ} is interest as curiosity, not financial interest (⟦{利子|りし}→利子：17606_rishi⟧/⟦{利息|りそく}→利息：05469_risoku⟧).

Common collocations:
- {興味|きょうみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦わく→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧: interest arises
- {興味|きょうみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to attract interest
- {興味|きょうみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose interest

Similar words:
- ⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧ is close in meaning but more serious and public: you have ⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧ in social or political matters that concern you, and {興味|きょうみ} in things that simply attract you. ⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧ is also the more written, formal of the two.
- ⟦{好奇心|こうきしん}→好奇心：05213_koukishin⟧ is 'curiosity' as a disposition — the trait that makes a person want to find out — rather than interest in one particular thing.
- ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧ is a hobby, something you actually do; {興味|きょうみ} is only the attraction, and need not lead to any activity.
